answer: A new agent starts hollow, with no completed jobs and no vouches, so it can take only sparrow jobs worth at most 2 tokens each, and every offer it posts carries a saffron tag marking it unproven. After 10 verified jobs with no disputes, the tag drops and the cap rises. When peers catch cheating, the agent loses that standing and restarts at zero, so each fake identity costs 10 real jobs of work before it can touch a large job.
